extend_for_v2v.behavior: Zero-extends the first nn.Linear input layer of model.actor and model.critic by extra_dim columns inserted at INSERT_AT=29 (end of the per-CAV x/pooled block, before the actor latent / critic rsu tails). Existing weights copied; all new input weights ZERO; biases untouched. extra_dim<=0 is a no-op. Outputs are identical to the original model for any finite extra input at load.

load_checkpoint.signature: load_checkpoint(path, config=None, v2v_dim=None) -> (policy, optimizer, generator, payload)
load_checkpoint.behavior: Flag off (default) delegates byte-identically to accel_learner.load. With v2v_dim=N or config={'v2v': True} (optional 'v2v_dim' override), loads then extends; Adam moments remapped index-for-index with zero gaps at the inserted columns, step counters preserved, lr preserved. Already-extended checkpoints of matching width load unchanged; mismatched width raises ValueError.

v2v_extra.behavior: Resolves extra width from config flag; 0 when flag off/absent.

forward_with_v2v.behavior: Base actor/critic forward over widened per-CAV features x (n, 29+extra) and rsu; provided for the observation-side integration.

V2V_DIM.behavior: Imported from tools/coopmwm/v2v_obs.py when present; local stub V2V_DIM=4 until that module lands.
